audience: Developers and open-source maintainers who want responsible social publishing

evidence.claim: ReachWeaver contains a Claude Code skill and a local-first publishing CLI; live integrations are limited.

The offline capability registry records API and approval status for 14 platforms: bluesky, mastodon, telegram, linkedin, x, threads, instagram, facebook, youtube, tiktok, reddit, pinterest, devto and hashnode.

variants.angle: Why a capability registry beats guessing what an API allows
variants.text:
Before a tool posts for you, it should know what each network actually allows.

ReachWeaver keeps an offline registry of API and approval status for 14 platforms. Anything unknown, gated or manual-only is refused instead of guessed.

Which platform rule has surprised you most?

https://github.com/MSKazemi/reachweaver #opensource #devtools
variants.cta: Invite maintainers to share a platform rule that surprised them
variants.rationale: Registry count is quoted from the registry file; the question invites discussion, not clicks.

variants.angle: Fail closed on unknown platform capabilities
variants.text: ReachWeaver refuses to publish where its registry marks a format as unknown, gated or manual-only. 14 platforms tracked, none assumed. https://github.com/MSKazemi/reachweaver #opensource

variants.angle: Three guardrails between a draft and a post
parts: Three guardrails sit between a ReachWeaver draft and a real post: https://github.com/MSKazemi/reachweaver
First, a human approves the exact text and account. Nothing is approved because a file validates.
Second, the capability registry fails closed: unknown, gated or manual-only formats are refused.
Third, an interrupted send is never retried blindly. A person reconciles what actually happened.
variants.cta: Invite maintainers to review the guardrails

variants.angle: From draft to receipt, one slide per gate
variants.text: How a draft becomes a post in ReachWeaver, one gate at a time. https://github.com/MSKazemi/reachweaver
slides: Draft: exact text, one account, cited evidence.
Approve: a human confirms the account and payload.
Send: only with an explicit live flag and opt-in.
Receipt: the platform's own post ID, or human reconciliation.
